global_groups.description: Consolidated global groups after deduplication and merging across all batches.

signal.description: Synthesized signal (1-6 words) capturing the common behavioral pattern across all merged local groups. May be one of the existing local signals or a new synthesis.

incident_ids.description: Union of all incident IDs from merged local groups, deduplicated. At least 2. Use EXACT IDs from input.

merged_from_batches.description: Indices (0-based) of the batches whose local groups were merged into this global group. At least 1.

confidence.description: Confidence in this merge. HIGH: clearly the same behavioral process across batches, rationales converge. MEDIUM: likely the same process but only confirmed in one batch, or minor divergence in rationales. LOW: forced merge due to similar surface signals but rationales describe possibly different processes.

original_signals.description: The original local group signals that were merged to form this global group. Provides traceability back to source batches.

conflict_note.description: If this merge involved conflict resolution (SPLIT decision, overlapping incidents, subset/superset), describe the conflict and how it was resolved. Empty string if no conflict.

total_local_groups_received.description: Total number of local groups received across all batches.

total_global_groups_produced.description: Total number of global groups after merging and deduplication.

merges_performed.description: Number of merge operations performed (two or more local groups combined into one global group).

splits_performed.description: Number of split operations performed (local groups with same signal separated into different global groups due to divergent rationales).

low_confidence_count.description: Number of global groups with confidence=LOW. These are candidates for ReAct exploration.

divergences_for_react.description: Groups flagged for potential ReAct exploration. Empty if no divergences.

global_group_signal.description: Signal of the global group with unresolved divergence.

reason.description: Reason this divergence needs ReAct exploration.

detail.description: Specific description of the divergence: which signals conflict, which batches disagree, what makes resolution ambiguous.
